#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render the Malaria Global Burden & Progress poster — Ember Cartography style. Refined pass."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, random, os

DPI = 150
W = int(23.39 * DPI)  # 3508
H = int(33.11 * DPI)  # 4966
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# --- Colors ---
BG        = (14, 18, 32)
BG_LIGHT  = (22, 28, 46)
AMBER     = (232, 180, 58)
AMBER_DIM = (160, 125, 40)
AMBER_SOFT= (200, 160, 55)
RED       = (195, 50, 50)
RED_GLOW  = (215, 65, 55)
RED_DARK  = (110, 35, 35)
WHITE     = (235, 235, 240)
GREY      = (120, 125, 145)
GREY_DARK = (50, 55, 70)
TEAL      = (55, 175, 165)

# --- Fonts ---
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML = 200
MR = 200
CW = W - ML - MR

def dt(xy, text, fnt, fill, anchor="lt"):
    if "\n" in text:
        draw.multiline_text(xy, text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text(xy, text, font=fnt, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hline(y, color=GREY_DARK, w=2):
    draw.line([(ML, y), (W - MR, y)], fill=color, width=w)

# --- Subtle background texture ---
random.seed(42)
for x in range(0, W, 36):
    for y in range(0, H, 36):
        if random.random() < 0.12:
            r = random.randint(1, 2)
            c = tuple(min(255, ch + random.randint(4, 10)) for ch in BG)
            draw.ellipse([x-r, y-r, x+r, y+r], fill=c)

y = 90
hline(y)
y += 25

# --- HEADER ---
dt((ML, y), "GLOBAL HEALTH DATA BRIEF", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 24), GREY)
y += 65
dt((ML, y), "MALARIA", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 240), WHITE)
y += 250
dt((ML, y), "A PREVENTABLE KILLER", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 78), AMBER)
y += 105

f_ital = font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 35)
subtitle = ("Over half a million people still die from malaria each year — most of them "
            "children — yet humanity has made remarkable progress eliminating the disease from half the world.")
words = subtitle.split()
line, lines = "", []
for w in words:
    test = f"{line} {w}".strip()
    if f_ital.getbbox(test)[2] > CW:
        lines.append(line); line = w
    else:
        line = test
if line: lines.append(line)
for l in lines:
    dt((ML, y), l, f_ital, GREY)
    y += 46
y += 25
hline(y)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# HERO: 1,320 — THE DOMINANT ELEMENT
# ============================================================
hero_y = y

# Vertical red accent bar
draw.rectangle([ML - 12, hero_y, ML + 10, hero_y + 490], fill=RED)

# The giant number
f_giant = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 380)
dt((ML + 50, hero_y - 40), "1,320", f_giant, RED_GLOW)

# Sublines
dt((ML + 50, hero_y + 340), "CHILDREN DIE EVERY DAY", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 88), WHITE)
dt((ML + 50, hero_y + 440), "FROM A DISEASE WE KNOW HOW TO PREVENT AND TREAT", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 40), AMBER_DIM)

y = hero_y + 530

# Dot visualization: 1,320 dots spanning full content width
dot_top = y
dot_left = ML + 50
dot_spacing = 13
cols = min(88, (CW - 100) // dot_spacing)
rows = math.ceil(1320 / cols)
random.seed(7)
count = 0
for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        if count >= 1320:
            break
        cx = dot_left + col * dot_spacing
        cy = dot_top + row * dot_spacing
        shade = random.randint(-20, 20)
        c = (min(255, 195 + shade), max(0, 50 + shade // 2), max(0, 50 + shade // 2))
        draw.ellipse([cx - 4, cy - 4, cx + 4, cy + 4], fill=c)
        count += 1

y = dot_top + rows * dot_spacing + 18
dt((ML + 50, y), "Each dot is one child. Every day.", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
y += 55
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 01: THE BURDEN
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "01", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "THE BURDEN: WHO MALARIA KILLS", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 75

box_w = (CW - 80) // 3
box_h = 180
stats_data = [
    (">500,000", "DEATHS PER YEAR", "2010s average", AMBER),
    ("CHILDREN UNDER 5", "MOST VULNERABLE", "Highest share of deaths", RED_GLOW),
    ("SUB-SAHARAN AFRICA", "MOST AFFECTED REGION", "Vast majority of deaths", AMBER_SOFT),
]
for i, (val, lbl, ctx, accent) in enumerate(stats_data):
    x0 = ML + i * (box_w + 40)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + box_w, y + box_h], fill=BG_LIGHT, outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
    # Top accent
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + box_w, y + 4], fill=accent)
    if i == 0:
        dt((x0 + 22, y + 20), val, font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90), accent)
        lbl_y = y + 115
    else:
        dt((x0 + 22, y + 22), val, font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38), accent)
        lbl_y = y + 100
    dt((x0 + 22, lbl_y), lbl, font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), WHITE)
    dt((x0 + 22, lbl_y + 28), ctx, font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18), GREY)

y += box_h + 25
dt((ML, y), "Caused by Plasmodium falciparum parasites, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes", font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 28), GREY)
y += 50
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 02: HISTORICAL PROGRESS
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "02", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "FROM HALF THE WORLD TO A QUARTER", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

half_w = (CW - 80) // 2

# 50% block
x1 = ML
draw.rectangle([x1, y, x1 + half_w, y + 280], outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 15), "~1900", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 48), "50%", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150), RED)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 210), "OF GLOBAL LAND WAS ENDEMIC", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30), WHITE)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 248), "Including Europe and North America", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

# Grid visualization for 50%
grid_l = x1 + half_w - 200
grid_t = y + 25
for row in range(10):
    for col in range(8):
        bx = grid_l + col * 22
        by = grid_t + row * 22
        draw.rectangle([bx, by, bx + 17, by + 17], fill=RED_DARK)

# Arrow between blocks
arrow_x = ML + half_w + 20
arrow_y = y + 130
draw.polygon([(arrow_x, arrow_y - 12), (arrow_x + 36, arrow_y), (arrow_x, arrow_y + 12)], fill=AMBER_DIM)

# 27% block
x2 = ML + half_w + 80
draw.rectangle([x2, y, x2 + half_w, y + 280], outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 15), "2002", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 48), "27%", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150), AMBER)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 210), "OF GLOBAL LAND STILL AT RISK", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30), WHITE)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 248), "Eliminated from Europe, E. Asia, Americas", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

# Grid visualization for 27% (smaller filled area)
grid_l2 = x2 + half_w - 160
grid_t2 = y + 40
for row in range(6):
    for col in range(5):
        bx = grid_l2 + col * 22
        by = grid_t2 + row * 22
        draw.rectangle([bx, by, bx + 17, by + 17], fill=AMBER_DIM)

y += 310

# Drivers
drivers = "Public health measures  ·  Land use change  ·  Economic development"
dt((ML, y), drivers, font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28), GREY)
y += 42
dt((ML, y), "Lincoln and Cromwell both contracted malaria — it was never just a 'tropical' disease.", font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 26), (90, 95, 110))
y += 50
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 03: DEATH TRENDS CHART
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "03", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "DEATH TOLL TRENDS: 2000-2023", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

chart_l = ML + 80
chart_r = W - MR - 20
chart_t = y
chart_b = y + 400
chart_w = chart_r - chart_l
chart_h = chart_b - chart_t

# Grid lines
for yv in [800, 600, 400, 200, 0]:
    yy = int(chart_b - (yv / 800) * chart_h)
    draw.line([(chart_l, yy), (chart_r, yy)], fill=GREY_DARK, width=1)
    dt((ML, yy - 10), f"{yv}K", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

who_data = [
    (2000, 720), (2001, 700), (2002, 680), (2003, 660), (2004, 640),
    (2005, 620), (2006, 590), (2007, 560), (2008, 530), (2009, 500),
    (2010, 490), (2011, 470), (2012, 460), (2013, 450), (2014, 440),
    (2015, 435), (2016, 440), (2017, 435), (2018, 440), (2019, 440),
    (2020, 520), (2021, 490), (2022, 470), (2023, 460),
]

def yx(yr): return int(chart_l + ((yr - 2000) / 23) * chart_w)
def yy(d): return int(chart_b - (d / 800) * chart_h)

pts = [(yx(yr), yy(d)) for yr, d in who_data]

# Area fill under curve (subtle gradient)
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    x0p, y0p = pts[i]
    x1p, y1p = pts[i + 1]
    for xx in range(x0p, x1p):
        frac = (xx - x0p) / max(1, x1p - x0p)
        yyp = int(y0p + frac * (y1p - y0p))
        for yyy in range(yyp, chart_b, 2):
            alpha = max(0, 30 - int(28 * (yyy - yyp) / max(1, chart_b - yyp)))
            c = (BG[0] + alpha * 2, BG[1] + alpha, BG[2])
            draw.point((xx, yyy), fill=c)

# COVID disruption zone highlight
covid_l = yx(2019)
covid_r = yx(2021)
for xx in range(covid_l, covid_r):
    for yyy in range(chart_t, chart_b):
        if random.random() < 0.02:
            draw.point((xx, yyy), fill=(RED_DARK[0], RED_DARK[1], RED_DARK[2]))

# Main line
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    draw.line([pts[i], pts[i+1]], fill=AMBER, width=5)

# Key year dots + labels
key_pts = {2000: "720K", 2005: "620K", 2010: "490K", 2015: "435K", 2020: "520K", 2023: "460K"}
for yr, lbl in key_pts.items():
    px, py = yx(yr), yy(dict(who_data)[yr])
    draw.ellipse([px-9, py-9, px+9, py+9], fill=AMBER, outline=BG, width=2)
    dt((px, py - 32), lbl, font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22), WHITE, anchor="mb")

# X-axis
for yr in [2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2023]:
    px = yx(yr)
    dt((px, chart_b + 12), str(yr), font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY, anchor="mt")

# Phase annotations
dt((int((yx(2000) + yx(2010)) / 2), chart_b + 45), "STEADY DECLINE", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), AMBER_DIM, anchor="mt")
dt((int((yx(2015) + yx(2019)) / 2), chart_b + 45), "STALLS", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY, anchor="mt")

# COVID label
cv_x = yx(2020)
cv_y = yy(520)
dt((cv_x + 50, cv_y - 55), "COVID-19", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 24), RED)
dt((cv_x + 50, cv_y - 28), "DISRUPTION", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18), RED)

y = chart_b + 80
dt((ML, y), "Based on WHO estimates  ·  IHME data shows similar trajectory with higher absolute figures", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)
y += 45
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 04: INTERVENTIONS
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "04", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "WHAT WORKS: TOOLS TO BEAT MALARIA", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

card_w = (CW - 80) // 3
card_h = 210
interventions = [
    ("INSECTICIDE-TREATED BEDNETS", "Most cost-effective health\nintervention — prevents bites\nduring sleep", TEAL),
    ("VACCINES", "New malaria vaccines provide\nadditional protection for\nchildren in endemic areas", AMBER),
    ("ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT", "Better housing, healthcare,\nand infrastructure reduce\ntransmission", (170, 155, 95)),
]

for i, (title, desc, accent) in enumerate(interventions):
    x0 = ML + i * (card_w + 40)
    # Accent bar top
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + card_w, y + 4], fill=accent)
    # Card
    draw.rectangle([x0, y + 4, x0 + card_w, y + card_h], fill=BG_LIGHT)
    # Title
    f_card_title = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
    title_lines = []
    tline = ""
    for tw in title.split():
        ttest = f"{tline} {tw}".strip()
        if f_card_title.getbbox(ttest)[2] > card_w - 44:
            title_lines.append(tline); tline = tw
        else:
            tline = ttest
    if tline: title_lines.append(tline)

    ty = y + 22
    for tl in title_lines:
        dt((x0 + 22, ty), tl, f_card_title, WHITE)
        ty += 38
    # Description
    ty += 8
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        dt((x0 + 22, ty), dl, font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), GREY)
        ty += 34

y += card_h + 50
hline(y, AMBER, 3)
y += 35

# ============================================================
# CALL TO ACTION
# ============================================================
f_cta = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
cta = ("Every day that passes without action, 1,320 children lose their lives to a disease "
       "we know how to prevent. The world has proven elimination is possible — "
       "the challenge now is extending that success to the regions that need it most.")
words = cta.split()
line, lines = "", []
for w in words:
    test = f"{line} {w}".strip()
    if f_cta.getbbox(test)[2] > CW - 60:
        lines.append(line); line = w
    else:
        line = test
if line: lines.append(line)
for l in lines:
    dt((ML + 30, y), l, f_cta, WHITE)
    y += 48
y += 22

dt((ML + 30, y), "ELIMINATION IS POSSIBLE. PROGRESS IS PROVEN. ACTION IS URGENT.", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36), AMBER)
y += 70

# Footer
hline(y, GREY_DARK, 1)
y += 18
dt((ML, y), "Sources: WHO World Malaria Report  ·  IHME Global Burden of Disease  ·  Our World in Data", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)
dt((W - MR, y), "Data visualization for public exhibition", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY, anchor="rt")

# Save
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H} at {DPI} DPI")

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render the Malaria Global Burden & Progress poster — Ember Cartography style. Refined pass."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, random, os

DPI = 150
W = int(23.39 * DPI)  # 3508
H = int(33.11 * DPI)  # 4966
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# --- Colors ---
BG        = (14, 18, 32)
BG_LIGHT  = (22, 28, 46)
AMBER     = (232, 180, 58)
AMBER_DIM = (160, 125, 40)
AMBER_SOFT= (200, 160, 55)
RED       = (195, 50, 50)
RED_GLOW  = (215, 65, 55)
RED_DARK  = (110, 35, 35)
WHITE     = (235, 235, 240)
GREY      = (120, 125, 145)
GREY_DARK = (50, 55, 70)
TEAL      = (55, 175, 165)

# --- Fonts ---
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML = 200
MR = 200
CW = W - ML - MR

def dt(xy, text, fnt, fill, anchor="lt"):
    if "\n" in text:
        draw.multiline_text(xy, text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text(xy, text, font=fnt, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def hline(y, color=GREY_DARK, w=2):
    draw.line([(ML, y), (W - MR, y)], fill=color, width=w)

# --- Subtle background texture ---
random.seed(42)
for x in range(0, W, 36):
    for y in range(0, H, 36):
        if random.random() < 0.12:
            r = random.randint(1, 2)
            c = tuple(min(255, ch + random.randint(4, 10)) for ch in BG)
            draw.ellipse([x-r, y-r, x+r, y+r], fill=c)

y = 90
hline(y)
y += 25

# --- HEADER ---
dt((ML, y), "GLOBAL HEALTH DATA BRIEF", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 24), GREY)
y += 65
dt((ML, y), "MALARIA", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 240), WHITE)
y += 250
dt((ML, y), "A PREVENTABLE KILLER", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 78), AMBER)
y += 105

f_ital = font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 35)
subtitle = ("Over half a million people still die from malaria each year — most of them "
            "children — yet humanity has made remarkable progress eliminating the disease from half the world.")
words = subtitle.split()
line, lines = "", []
for w in words:
    test = f"{line} {w}".strip()
    if f_ital.getbbox(test)[2] > CW:
        lines.append(line); line = w
    else:
        line = test
if line: lines.append(line)
for l in lines:
    dt((ML, y), l, f_ital, GREY)
    y += 46
y += 25
hline(y)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# HERO: 1,320 — THE DOMINANT ELEMENT
# ============================================================
hero_y = y

# Vertical red accent bar
draw.rectangle([ML - 12, hero_y, ML + 10, hero_y + 490], fill=RED)

# The giant number
f_giant = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 380)
dt((ML + 50, hero_y - 40), "1,320", f_giant, RED_GLOW)

# Sublines
dt((ML + 50, hero_y + 340), "CHILDREN DIE EVERY DAY", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 88), WHITE)
dt((ML + 50, hero_y + 440), "FROM A DISEASE WE KNOW HOW TO PREVENT AND TREAT", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 40), AMBER_DIM)

y = hero_y + 530

# Dot visualization: 1,320 dots spanning full content width
dot_top = y
dot_left = ML + 50
dot_spacing = 13
cols = min(88, (CW - 100) // dot_spacing)
rows = math.ceil(1320 / cols)
random.seed(7)
count = 0
for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        if count >= 1320:
            break
        cx = dot_left + col * dot_spacing
        cy = dot_top + row * dot_spacing
        shade = random.randint(-20, 20)
        c = (min(255, 195 + shade), max(0, 50 + shade // 2), max(0, 50 + shade // 2))
        draw.ellipse([cx - 4, cy - 4, cx + 4, cy + 4], fill=c)
        count += 1

y = dot_top + rows * dot_spacing + 18
dt((ML + 50, y), "Each dot is one child. Every day.", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
y += 55
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 01: THE BURDEN
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "01", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "THE BURDEN: WHO MALARIA KILLS", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 75

box_w = (CW - 80) // 3
box_h = 180
stats_data = [
    (">500,000", "DEATHS PER YEAR", "2010s average", AMBER),
    ("CHILDREN UNDER 5", "MOST VULNERABLE", "Highest share of deaths", RED_GLOW),
    ("SUB-SAHARAN AFRICA", "MOST AFFECTED REGION", "Vast majority of deaths", AMBER_SOFT),
]
for i, (val, lbl, ctx, accent) in enumerate(stats_data):
    x0 = ML + i * (box_w + 40)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + box_w, y + box_h], fill=BG_LIGHT, outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
    # Top accent
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + box_w, y + 4], fill=accent)
    if i == 0:
        dt((x0 + 22, y + 20), val, font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90), accent)
        lbl_y = y + 115
    else:
        dt((x0 + 22, y + 22), val, font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38), accent)
        lbl_y = y + 100
    dt((x0 + 22, lbl_y), lbl, font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), WHITE)
    dt((x0 + 22, lbl_y + 28), ctx, font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18), GREY)

y += box_h + 25
dt((ML, y), "Caused by Plasmodium falciparum parasites, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes", font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 28), GREY)
y += 50
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 02: HISTORICAL PROGRESS
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "02", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "FROM HALF THE WORLD TO A QUARTER", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

half_w = (CW - 80) // 2

# 50% block
x1 = ML
draw.rectangle([x1, y, x1 + half_w, y + 280], outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 15), "~1900", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 48), "50%", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150), RED)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 210), "OF GLOBAL LAND WAS ENDEMIC", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30), WHITE)
dt((x1 + 28, y + 248), "Including Europe and North America", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

# Grid visualization for 50%
grid_l = x1 + half_w - 200
grid_t = y + 25
for row in range(10):
    for col in range(8):
        bx = grid_l + col * 22
        by = grid_t + row * 22
        draw.rectangle([bx, by, bx + 17, by + 17], fill=RED_DARK)

# Arrow between blocks
arrow_x = ML + half_w + 20
arrow_y = y + 130
draw.polygon([(arrow_x, arrow_y - 12), (arrow_x + 36, arrow_y), (arrow_x, arrow_y + 12)], fill=AMBER_DIM)

# 27% block
x2 = ML + half_w + 80
draw.rectangle([x2, y, x2 + half_w, y + 280], outline=GREY_DARK, width=1)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 15), "2002", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 48), "27%", font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150), AMBER)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 210), "OF GLOBAL LAND STILL AT RISK", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30), WHITE)
dt((x2 + 28, y + 248), "Eliminated from Europe, E. Asia, Americas", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

# Grid visualization for 27% (smaller filled area)
grid_l2 = x2 + half_w - 160
grid_t2 = y + 40
for row in range(6):
    for col in range(5):
        bx = grid_l2 + col * 22
        by = grid_t2 + row * 22
        draw.rectangle([bx, by, bx + 17, by + 17], fill=AMBER_DIM)

y += 310

# Drivers
drivers = "Public health measures  ·  Land use change  ·  Economic development"
dt((ML, y), drivers, font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28), GREY)
y += 42
dt((ML, y), "Lincoln and Cromwell both contracted malaria — it was never just a 'tropical' disease.", font("Lora-Italic.ttf", 26), (90, 95, 110))
y += 50
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 03: DEATH TRENDS CHART
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "03", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "DEATH TOLL TRENDS: 2000-2023", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

chart_l = ML + 80
chart_r = W - MR - 20
chart_t = y
chart_b = y + 400
chart_w = chart_r - chart_l
chart_h = chart_b - chart_t

# Grid lines
for yv in [800, 600, 400, 200, 0]:
    yy = int(chart_b - (yv / 800) * chart_h)
    draw.line([(chart_l, yy), (chart_r, yy)], fill=GREY_DARK, width=1)
    dt((ML, yy - 10), f"{yv}K", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)

who_data = [
    (2000, 720), (2001, 700), (2002, 680), (2003, 660), (2004, 640),
    (2005, 620), (2006, 590), (2007, 560), (2008, 530), (2009, 500),
    (2010, 490), (2011, 470), (2012, 460), (2013, 450), (2014, 440),
    (2015, 435), (2016, 440), (2017, 435), (2018, 440), (2019, 440),
    (2020, 520), (2021, 490), (2022, 470), (2023, 460),
]

def yx(yr): return int(chart_l + ((yr - 2000) / 23) * chart_w)
def yy(d): return int(chart_b - (d / 800) * chart_h)

pts = [(yx(yr), yy(d)) for yr, d in who_data]

# Area fill under curve (subtle gradient)
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    x0p, y0p = pts[i]
    x1p, y1p = pts[i + 1]
    for xx in range(x0p, x1p):
        frac = (xx - x0p) / max(1, x1p - x0p)
        yyp = int(y0p + frac * (y1p - y0p))
        for yyy in range(yyp, chart_b, 2):
            alpha = max(0, 30 - int(28 * (yyy - yyp) / max(1, chart_b - yyp)))
            c = (BG[0] + alpha * 2, BG[1] + alpha, BG[2])
            draw.point((xx, yyy), fill=c)

# COVID disruption zone highlight
covid_l = yx(2019)
covid_r = yx(2021)
for xx in range(covid_l, covid_r):
    for yyy in range(chart_t, chart_b):
        if random.random() < 0.02:
            draw.point((xx, yyy), fill=(RED_DARK[0], RED_DARK[1], RED_DARK[2]))

# Main line
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    draw.line([pts[i], pts[i+1]], fill=AMBER, width=5)

# Key year dots + labels
key_pts = {2000: "720K", 2005: "620K", 2010: "490K", 2015: "435K", 2020: "520K", 2023: "460K"}
for yr, lbl in key_pts.items():
    px, py = yx(yr), yy(dict(who_data)[yr])
    draw.ellipse([px-9, py-9, px+9, py+9], fill=AMBER, outline=BG, width=2)
    dt((px, py - 32), lbl, font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 22), WHITE, anchor="mb")

# X-axis
for yr in [2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2023]:
    px = yx(yr)
    dt((px, chart_b + 12), str(yr), font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22), GREY, anchor="mt")

# Phase annotations
dt((int((yx(2000) + yx(2010)) / 2), chart_b + 45), "STEADY DECLINE", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), AMBER_DIM, anchor="mt")
dt((int((yx(2015) + yx(2019)) / 2), chart_b + 45), "STALLS", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY, anchor="mt")

# COVID label
cv_x = yx(2020)
cv_y = yy(520)
dt((cv_x + 50, cv_y - 55), "COVID-19", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 24), RED)
dt((cv_x + 50, cv_y - 28), "DISRUPTION", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18), RED)

y = chart_b + 80
dt((ML, y), "Based on WHO estimates  ·  IHME data shows similar trajectory with higher absolute figures", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)
y += 45
hline(y)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# SECTION 04: INTERVENTIONS
# ============================================================
dt((ML, y), "04", font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28), AMBER_DIM)
dt((ML + 80, y - 2), "WHAT WORKS: TOOLS TO BEAT MALARIA", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48), WHITE)
y += 80

card_w = (CW - 80) // 3
card_h = 210
interventions = [
    ("INSECTICIDE-TREATED BEDNETS", "Most cost-effective health\nintervention — prevents bites\nduring sleep", TEAL),
    ("VACCINES", "New malaria vaccines provide\nadditional protection for\nchildren in endemic areas", AMBER),
    ("ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT", "Better housing, healthcare,\nand infrastructure reduce\ntransmission", (170, 155, 95)),
]

for i, (title, desc, accent) in enumerate(interventions):
    x0 = ML + i * (card_w + 40)
    # Accent bar top
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x0 + card_w, y + 4], fill=accent)
    # Card
    draw.rectangle([x0, y + 4, x0 + card_w, y + card_h], fill=BG_LIGHT)
    # Title
    f_card_title = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
    title_lines = []
    tline = ""
    for tw in title.split():
        ttest = f"{tline} {tw}".strip()
        if f_card_title.getbbox(ttest)[2] > card_w - 44:
            title_lines.append(tline); tline = tw
        else:
            tline = ttest
    if tline: title_lines.append(tline)

    ty = y + 22
    for tl in title_lines:
        dt((x0 + 22, ty), tl, f_card_title, WHITE)
        ty += 38
    # Description
    ty += 8
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        dt((x0 + 22, ty), dl, font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), GREY)
        ty += 34

y += card_h + 50
hline(y, AMBER, 3)
y += 35

# ============================================================
# CALL TO ACTION
# ============================================================
f_cta = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
cta = ("Every day that passes without action, 1,320 children lose their lives to a disease "
       "we know how to prevent. The world has proven elimination is possible — "
       "the challenge now is extending that success to the regions that need it most.")
words = cta.split()
line, lines = "", []
for w in words:
    test = f"{line} {w}".strip()
    if f_cta.getbbox(test)[2] > CW - 60:
        lines.append(line); line = w
    else:
        line = test
if line: lines.append(line)
for l in lines:
    dt((ML + 30, y), l, f_cta, WHITE)
    y += 48
y += 22

dt((ML + 30, y), "ELIMINATION IS POSSIBLE. PROGRESS IS PROVEN. ACTION IS URGENT.", font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36), AMBER)
y += 70

# Footer
hline(y, GREY_DARK, 1)
y += 18
dt((ML, y), "Sources: WHO World Malaria Report  ·  IHME Global Burden of Disease  ·  Our World in Data", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY)
dt((W - MR, y), "Data visualization for public exhibition", font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20), GREY, anchor="rt")

# Save
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H} at {DPI} DPI")
